artworks.title: Une Terrible rencontre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a countryside scene with windmills in the distance. The foreground depicts an older man with a walking stick and a woman, both dressed in 19th-century attire, being approached by a small dog. The man appears startled, stepping back protectively, while holding the woman's hand. The background features a pastoral landscape with rolling hills and several windmills, adding depth to the scene. The drawing captures a surprising encounter during a stroll in the countryside, with the characters' reactions and the rural setting contributing to the overall narrative.

artworks.title: Vas-tu te taire avec tes Cocoricos...
artworks.description: This is a monochromatic sketch of an interior. There is a bed with a figure pulling a curtain and looking towards an open window where a rooster is perched. A chair nearby has some articles, and a small round table with a tall object stands beside the bed. The drawing depicts fabric folds and lines in the drapery and bedding, highlighting the textured atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Et dire que c'est aujourd'hui la Saint-Médard!
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a group of people seated indoors, looking out at the rain through open double doors. In a room lined with classical furniture and framed pictures on the walls, three individuals sit on the left side, facing another person on the right. Their expressions suggest they are watching the scene outside, dominated by heavy rainfall. The drawing style uses strong contrasts of light and shadow, emphasizing the storm against the indoor setting. The room's decoration, the attire of the seated individuals, and the line work are reminiscent of 19th-century European culture. The mood presented is one of quiet reflection, as the characters seem isolated from the weather outside.

artworks.title: Comment trouvez-vous ce petit vin-la...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals around a large wine barrel. The scene is depicted in a sketch with varying shades of gray. The people are engaged in a discussion. The person at the forefront appears to be holding a glass. Another figure stands nearby gesturing something. The features are cartoon-like and exaggerated. Above the scene, the text "Pastorales" is written. A handwritten caption beneath the drawing in French adds context to the scene.

artworks.title: Oh!... une bête a cornes...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a tree with a cow standing beside it. The drawing shows a large tree with dense foliage at the top. Below the tree, a cow appears to be walking in from the right side. The ground around the tree is uneven. The cow has curved horns and a muscular build, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. Shadows and light are used to create depth. The drawing includes illustrative lines and details, characteristic of a classic style of illustration or caricature art.

artworks.title: Désagrément de diner au trop grand air
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a disrupted picnic in a windy outdoor setting. The scene shows individuals trying to save their picnic amidst gusts of wind. The drawing includes humorous exaggerations typical of caricature with exaggerated facial expressions suggesting distress and surprise. Picnic items such as plates, a hat, and a cloth are being swept away by the wind. One person clings onto a tree while others attempt to gather the scattering items. The backdrop includes a couple of trees and open land, emphasizing the outdoor location. The style is reminiscent of the works of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Intérieur d'un omnibus
artworks.description: Three individuals are sitting closely together. On the left, a man with scruffy hair and a worn expression leans forward, resting his elbow on his knee with his hand dangling down. In the center, a woman sits upright with closed eyes, wearing a bonnet. She holds an umbrella or cane in front of her. The man on the right leans against the woman, with his face resting against his hand. He wears a top hat, a scarf, and layered clothing, with a noticeable checkered pattern on his vest. The background suggests they are inside a public transport vehicle, with a sign partially visible above them.

artworks.title: Intérieur d'un omnibus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a cramped space, presumably inside a public transport vehicle. The image features exaggerated expressions and postures. The character to the left has a tired and disheveled appearance. In the center, a figure with a bonnet tilts their head to one side. To the right is another character who appears somewhat inebriated, slumping to one side with a top hat. Surrounding the image is French text.

artworks.title: Domino!!
artworks.description: The image shows four people playing dominoes. Two men in the foreground are sitting at a table. The man on the left has a balding head and curly hair on the sides, with large eyes and a wide mouth. He wears a dark jacket and a light shirt. The man on the right has short dark hair and intense eyes, holding dominoes. In the background, two other figures are visible; one wearing a tall hat and long coat in profile, the other facing forward with a downturned hat. The setting is indoors with a textured wall and shadows.

artworks.title: Pas fameux? N'est-ce pas!!...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three characters looking at a publication titled "La Caricature Provisoire." The drawing depicts two men and a young girl, with the men closely observing a publication held by the girl sitting next to them. The man to the left appears to be peering over the shoulder of the man in the middle, who is holding the paper with a dubious or critical expression, while the girl appears indifferent or unimpressed. The characters are drawn in a caricature style, with exaggerated facial features. The image is richly detailed, with shading and linework that brings out the expressions and personalities of the characters. The text below, "Pas fameux? N'est-ce pas?", suggests a caption that reinforces the humorous aspect of the image.

artworks.title: B'en parlez pas j'suis enrubé du cerbeaux...
artworks.description: The image is an illustrated caricature showing two women engaged in conversation. They have different facial features and are dressed in dark, period-appropriate clothing. The woman on the left is hunched with her hands clasped, while the woman on the right holds a wicker basket in her left arm. They are set against an urban background with buildings and a crowd of people.

artworks.title: Moi je suis ravitaillé!...
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man with open arms and smiling. He has curly hair, a bushy mustache and beard, and is wearing a dark jacket over a light shirt with a scarf tied around his neck. On the table in front of him are plates with food, a glass of dark liquid, and a large piece of bread or pastry. The background is plain.

artworks.title: On flaire la marchandise... avant de la mécaniser!...
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a butcher and an older woman, both visible from the waist up. The butcher is on the left, leaning over a table with meat products, featuring short, tousled hair and wearing a collared shirt and apron. His exaggerated expression shows large eyes and an open mouth. The older woman is seated beside him, slightly leaning over towards a plate with meat. She wears a large bonnet covering her hair, and her face is drawn with prominent features, draped in a cloak or shawl. Various items are on the table, including a large sheet of paper or cloth and several plates of food. Additionally, sausages and meats hang in the background, creating a butcher shop atmosphere. The setting is monochrome, suggesting a sketchy, comical style with an indoor, shop-related backdrop.

artworks.title: Il y a pourtant des gens qui ressemblent a ça!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two people examining a caricature of themselves on the front page of a publication. The scene depicted in the publication titled "La Caricature Provisoire" shows an elderly man and a woman with exaggerated facial features, engaged in looking at and discussing a caricature. The man is pointing at the caricature, which is featured on the cover. The artwork uses black and white lines to emphasize expressions and details. The lower portion of the image contains columns of text.

artworks.title: Voila!... un fameux temps pour les petits pois...
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two men in top hats gesturing towards each other on a street. The image shows a caricature of the individuals dressed in early 19th-century attire, with formal coats and tall top hats. They are facing each other on an urban street, with expressive hand movements and open mouths indicating possible conversation or debate. In the background, there are loosely detailed buildings suggesting a city setting. Below the drawing, there is a block of French text, resembling a newspaper or magazine page layout, titled "Les Lilas et les Près Saint-Gervais." The drawing style reflects exaggerated expressions and satirical undertones similar to the work of Honoré Daumier, known for his social and political cartoons during the 19th century.

artworks.title: Ah! ça mais... arriverons-nous bientôt?
artworks.description: This image depicts a person looking through a floor trapdoor from below. The room has a textured or patterned wall. An elderly figure stands inside the room, bent forward while holding a set of keys. Another figure is partially visible from the trapdoor, their hands clasped on the edge as they look upwards. The drawing seems to focus on the interaction between these two figures in a confined space. The title at the top is "LOCATAIRES ET PROPRIÉTAIRES," suggesting a relationship dynamic.

artworks.title: Inconvénient de demander des réparations...
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a laborer working on top of a building or large piece of furniture, another person below dealing with falling debris, and a third figure observing. The scene conveys inconvenience and unexpected challenges during repairs. The drawing style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Un Déménagement furtif
artworks.description: Three men in the foreground are depicted. The two men on the sides are supporting a large coat draped over what seems to be a mannequin or a limp figure. The full bodies of the three figures are visible. The man on the left is wearing a bowler hat and a plaid scarf, looking backward with his hand gesturing. The man on the right is wearing a beret-style cap, looking forward with a focused expression. Both men are dressed in dark coats and trousers. The mannequin in the middle is adorned with an overcoat, a checked shirt, and a flat cap. In the background, an elderly-looking individual with spectacles is observing the scene from inside a lit room. The setting indicates an indoor corridor or entrance hall, mostly in shadow with light coming from the room where the observer stands.

artworks.title: Le Cordon donc!...
artworks.description: The image portrays a man looking through a window with a top hat on, and another person seated inside a dimly lit room beside a stove, wrapped in a blanket and wearing a cap.Beside the seated person is a pot on the stove, and on the wall is a poster or image.

artworks.title: Ah! il m'a donné congé...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. One person on the left is removing wallpaper from a wall using both hands. He has a focused expression, dark disheveled hair, and is wearing a knee-length dark robe with striped pants. Two others on the right are moving a large piece of furniture, with visible legs. They are wearing short-sleeved shirts and tight-fitting pants. The background features a room with walls showing torn, patterned wallpaper and a floor with scattered ripped wallpaper pieces.

artworks.title: Inconvénient de louer... non loin d'une rivière
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking across a flooded floor. He is bent over slightly, holding a wicker basket in front of him with both hands. In his left hand, he holds a lit candle. He has a long nose, wide eyes, light-colored short hair, and wears a dark coat. His feet are half submerged in the water on the wooden floor. Water is leaking through the stone walls and ceiling in the background.

artworks.title: Je ne loue pas aux gens qui ont des enfants!
artworks.description: The image shows three people from head to toe: an elderly woman sitting in an armchair, holding a small dog on her lap, a woman standing next to her in profile view, wearing a shawl or cloak, and a young child standing next to the woman, holding onto her clothing. The elderly woman has curly hair and a stern expression, while the standing woman has tightly pulled back hair. The child is dressed in a striped outfit with short pants and looks down. Adjacent to the seated woman, there is a fireplace with a parrot on a perch above it, and a birdcage hanging on the wall behind her. On the floor, a small dog is looking up at the seated woman, while another dog is resting near the fireplace. The background features a plain wall with simple decorations, suggesting an indoor room setting.

artworks.title: C'est unique! j'ai pris quatre tailles...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man looking at a shop window display of corsets. The man is dressed in formal attire with a tall hat, leaning towards the shop window. In the image, he appears intrigued or scrutinizing the corsets displayed on shelves. The drawing portrays a humorous or satirical tone commonly found in illustrations depicting everyday scenes with a hint of caricature. The background shows an interior space where the man, holding a walking stick, is positioned confidently. The corsets on the shelves are detailed, emphasizing their shape and structure. The artwork appears to be a print or a lithograph based on its style and the signature at the bottom, giving it a historical artistic quality.

artworks.title: Ah! Excusez
artworks.description: This is an image showing two figures in a humorous and exaggerated scenario with a large wooden plank. One figure steps backward with a startled expression as they are hit in the face by the plank being carried by the other figure. The person's face is mostly obscured by the plank. The setting seems to be an interior space with a wood-paneled or stage-like environment. The artwork features exaggerated expressions and postures, typical of caricature art styles.
